SELECT ah.purchase_arrival_id AS purchaseArrivalId, ad.purchase_arrival_detail_id AS purchaseArrivalDetailId, ah.arrival_no AS arrivalNo, ah.arrival_dt AS arrivalDt, c.customer_name AS supplierName, u.user_nm AS receiverName, CASE WHEN ah.use_at = 'Y' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CANCELED' END AS status, ah.tax_type AS taxType, tci.item_nm AS taxTypeName, ah.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, ah.supply_amt AS headerSupplyAmt, ah.vat_amt AS headerVatAmt, ah.total_amt AS headerTotalAmt, ah.remark AS headerRemark, ad.line_no AS lineNo, oh.order_no AS orderNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, od.order_qty AS orderQty, ad.arrival_qty AS arrivalQty, ad.unit_price AS unitPrice, ad.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, ad.vat_amt AS vatAmt, ad.total_amt AS totalAmt, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, ad.manufacture_dt AS manufactureDt, ad.expire_dt AS expireDt, ad.lot_no AS lotNo, ad.inspect_at AS inspectAt, ad.remark AS remark FROM tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad ON ad.purchase_arrival_id = ah.purchase_arrival_id AND ad.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_dt od ON od.purchase_order_detail_id = ad.purchase_order_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = ah.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = ah.receiver_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = ad.material_id AND m.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = ad.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group tcg ON tcg.tenant_id = ah.tenant_id AND tcg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item tci ON tci.group_id = tcg.common_code_group_id AND tci.item_code = ah.tax_type WHERE ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND ah.use_at = 'Y'
AND ah.use_at = 'N'
AND (ah.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND ah.arrival_no ILIKE '%' || #{arrivalNo} || '%'
AND c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{supplierKeyword} || '%'
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{materialKeyword} || '%')
AND oh.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{orderNo} || '%'
AND ah.arrival_dt >= CAST(#{arrivalDtFrom} AS date)
AND ah.arrival_dt <= CAST(#{arrivalDtTo} AS date)
ORDER BY ah.arrival_dt DESC, ah.arrival_no DESC, ad.line_no
